# Aliexpress.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/aliexpress-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/aliexpress-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Aliexpress.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Aliexpress.com (2025 Update)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-aliexpress)
- **Code:** [`aliexpress.py`](aliexpress.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Product pages](results/product.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json) · [Product reviews](results/reviews.json) · [Category products](results/category_products.json)

## What it scrapes

- Aliexpress product data
- Aliexpress product review data
- Aliexpress product search

## Functions

- `scrape_search(url, max_pages=60)`: Scrape all search results and return parsed search result data
- `scrape_product(url)` → `List[Product]`: scrape aliexpress products by id
- `scrape_product_reviews(product_id, max_scrape_pages=None)`: scrape all reviews of aliexpress product

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import aliexpress


async def main():
    search = await aliexpress.scrape_search(
        "https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-drills.html?catId=0&SearchText=drills",
        max_pages=2,
    )
    product = await aliexpress.scrape_product("https://www.aliexpress.com/item/3256807619226115.html")
    product_reviews = await aliexpress.scrape_product_reviews("1005006717259012", max_scrape_pages=3)


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`Product`**: `info`, `pricing`, `specifications`, `shipping`, `faqs`, `seller`, `reviewData`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`aliexpress.py`](aliexpress.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `headers` = `{"cookie": "aep_usuc_f=site=glo&province=&city=&c_tp=USD&region=US&b_locale=en_US&ae_u_p_s=2"}`

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/aliexpress-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`, `test_review_scraping`, `test_category_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
